package rulefixtures

// scenario for slice_grow_without_cap_hint: `var result []T` followed by `append` in a loop where the iteration count is visible from a `len()` or range source
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: warning.

type Record struct {
	Tags []string
}

func scenario639Positive(records []Record) []string {
	var collected []string
	for _, rec := range records {
		for _, tag := range rec.Tags {
			if len(tag) > 0 {
				collected = append(collected, tag)
			}
		}
	}
	return collected
}
